rows.text: promoter-group lender Katra Holding converts a Rs 12.47 cr unsecured loan into 6,55,000 shares at Rs 190.37 (preferential, non-cash), raising its stake from 4.85% to 9.41% (~6.55% of mcap).

its board approves a **preferential issue of 7,20,000 shares at Rs 190.37, Rs 13,70,66,400**, to promoter-group lender Katra Holding, partially adjusting an existing unsecured loan of Rs 26,41,20,000; subject to shareholder approval at the 28 September AGM.
